detail.longDescription: I started this project in 2024 when I got fascinated with LLMs, and what I did was a coding agent (CLI -> interactive -> GUI). I also added an integration with Vite for having it embedded inside my apps(mostly games). Few months ago I pivoted it to become a low profile AI provider wrapper library (think jQuery for LLM usage), because I realized there is no point to have custom coding agent. Recently I did yet another pivot, and now it is a solution that allows you to embed Claude Code inside of your app, and use it directly from there for 1. development, 2. every day ops and automate the tasks in the app In theory all you need to try it is this command: `npx genaicode embed`, I wonder if anyone would like to give it a try, and let me know how it worked!
